name: Onnasamurai Tsubaki ~Youma Ningun no Yabou o Soshi Seyo!~
original_name: 女侍ツバキ ～妖魔忍軍の野望を阻止せよ!～
source:
"Signs of the Resurrection of the Demon"

A ninja group, the Demon Ninja Army, has appeared, plotting to awaken the sealed demons and disrupt the world! The female samurai Tsubaki, praised for her swordsmanship, is personally entrusted by the feudal lord with the mission to eliminate the Demon Ninja Army and sets off on her journey.
translation: 《恶魔复活的预兆》一个忍者团体——恶魔忍者军出现，密谋唤醒被封印的恶魔，扰乱世界！因剑术而受到赞誉的女武士椿，受领主亲自委托，肩负消灭魔忍军的使命，踏上征途。
